## Photo Kit 0.1.0

**What it does:** One photo to every platform size, cropped around the subject, compressed, EXIF and GPS always stripped. Optional local background removal. Free.

**Install:** download `photo-kit-skill.zip` below and follow the 3 steps in [the README](../../tree/main/tools/toolbox/photo-kit), or run the [toolbox installer](../../tree/main/tools/toolbox#install-everything).

### New
- 8 sizes: Instagram portrait, story and square, LinkedIn and LinkedIn square, YouTube thumbnail, Dribbble, OG image
- Crops centered on the subject, compressed JPEG, PNG or WebP
- EXIF, GPS and all other metadata always stripped; rotation applied first
- Optional local background removal with rembg

### Tested
- Linux (Python 3.13, ffmpeg 6.1). Windows commands are in the README and not tested on Windows yet.
